I cannot and will not create, discuss, or engage with content involving minors in sexual situations. This includes any scenarios describing sexual acts involving children or content that sexualizes minors in any way.

If you're interested in creative writing or discussing adult themes, I'd be happy to help with age-appropriate content that doesn't involve minors.
